'''Camp Danger''' was a hidden outpost situated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the camp was used as a base-of-operations by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shorwarr]] and a group of [[Big game hunter/Legends|Big-game hunters]], from which they attempted to track Cholganna's native [[Nexu/Legends|Nexu]].
